rows.claim: If the deck treats an end date as the last active day, the active count and MRR would each rise by those two subscriptions
rows.evidence: The tool output showed 'end==oct1 count 2', so two subscriptions end exactly on 2026-10-01. The agent's filter used end_date > d, so they were excluded. Treating the end date as the last active day would add both to the active count and to MRR. The 'rise by those two subscriptions' phrasing is accurate, though the MRR increase depends on their plans, which were not shown.
